snippet.title: Hivefront TD -  Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hivefront TD is set to be available on Steam, iOS and Android!

Hivefront TD is a top down, strategy, tower defense game. Collect an insect army and defend your hive as either Ants or Bees in this completely hand-drawn tower defense adventure.

Super Ant and Mecha Ant were comic book characters created by us in second grade. We decided we finally wanted to give them the love they deserve--by making them a video game. In this game, use Super Ant, Mecha Ant, and collect tons of other towers to defend your insect base with and destroy waves upon waves of enemy attacks from opposing teams. Can you defend the hive?
